title: Amorph
description: Six Beatles album covers printed in tens of thousands of dots of ink. Every few seconds, or wherever you click, the next cover ripples out across the print: a clean wavefront swells each dot, nudges it outward on a short trail and settles it into its new colour.
intent: A designed transition instead of random flight: every dot keeps its place on the halftone grid and the next cover travels through them as one ripple from a corner or from your click, so the change reads as a wave, not a scramble.
